contributionMap.claim: Counterexamples at minimum degree (1/2 + o(1)) log2 n; the weighted criterion sum_v (deg v + 2) 2^(-deg v - 1) <= 1 forces unimodality with a central mode, so minimum degree log2 n + log2 log2 n + 1 suffices; this is sharp up to an additive constant for the central mode

limitationTriage.limitation: The least minimum degree forcing unimodality is not determined
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Is the constant gamma in (gamma + o(1)) log2 n equal to 1/2, 1 or in between?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: lower 1/2 from the construction, upper 1 from the weighted criterion; a gadget with fewer clauses per block was considered
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: needs a new construction or a new upper-bound argument

limitationTriage.closingQuestion: How small can a counterexample be?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: the 317,440-vertex example was chosen for a short certificate, not for small order
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: a minimisation is a separate project

limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Is the domination polynomial of every tree unimodal?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: the phase-coexistence construction needs cycles and large degrees or a clique

limitationTriage.limitation: The linear mode-average constant is of order 1e-25
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Can Theorem 1.3(a) be made explicit with a reasonable constant?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: constant stated in Remark 6.1; an explicit expander was considered and estimated at days of work
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: the explicit finite answer (gap > 88) is given instead

limitationTriage.limitation: Effective thresholds for the asymptotic theorems
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: At what orders do Theorem 1.2 and Theorem 1.4(iii) start?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: explicit K = 4, 8, 16 instances of Theorem 1.2 checked exactly; explicit thresholds 2^20 (even) and 2^40 (odd) proved for Theorem 1.4(iii)

limitationTriage.limitation: Certified average size and mode exclusion relied on floating-point output
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Is the explicit mode-average gap certified?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: dual-number transfer matrix with outward rounding and an exact scan of every index in [160217, 160412]; matched by an independent 120-digit recomputation in review

limitationTriage.limitation: Computational checks could pass vacuously under optimisation
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Do the checks fail when a value is wrong?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: assert statements replaced by explicit checks that exit 1; three negative controls exit 1 under python -O

limitationTriage.limitation: Novelty rests on searches of limited scope
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: arXiv API, web and Crossref searches, citing works of Beaton-Brown, Evidence Press corpus
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: MathSciNet and zbMATH were outside the searched corpus
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: recorded here; the paper claims only that no earlier counterexample was found
